# Amcache test hives

- `plaso-Amcache.hve`, `plaso-win10-Amcache.hve`: real hives from plaso's test
  data (`test_data/winreg/`, commit ac6da7129f6cf3f43a352b6c4906374cf071533e),
  Apache License 2.0 (`LICENSE-plaso.txt`). The first holds both layouts.

`../oracle/amcache/<hive>/` holds AmcacheParser's output for each (Eric
Zimmerman's EZ Tools, run with `-i --nl`), with the run's timestamp prefix
removed from the file names.
